reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and adds one shared isWeekendOrHoliday predicate in shared/schedules.ts, which every weekend check (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) now uses.

duplication.why: No new duplicated logic; it even collapses the two copied weekend-adjust expressions in schedule-template.ts into one local adjustWeekend closure, though holidays is still threaded by hand at each call.

placement.why: The day-skipping rule stays in shared/schedules.ts; server callers and parseRecurDate only pass the config field through.

scope.why: Only the rule, its callers, the config type and the recur parser change; the schedule-template tidy-up is in the touched code path.

maintainability.why: Single predicate holds the rule; the optional holidays argument means a future caller could forget it, and the unknown-solve-mode branch in getDateWithSkippedWeekend is a little convoluted.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All raw d.isWeekend checks on schedule occurrences were replaced by isWeekendOrHoliday; all getDateWithSkippedWeekend calls pass holidays.

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts; every call site (shared getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, budget/schedule-template.ts) routes through them with the config's holidays.
